choices.topic: Which average is printed in brackets next to each effect?
choices.opus: Model-based averages (geometric means; for mistakes, predicted chance of any mistake), 5% to 45% below printed values.
choices.sonnet: Plain average over all valid knots; mistakes as average count per knot. Matches nearly all printed values.
choices.authors: Plain average per run first, then average of the three runs; for mistakes the average count, not the share.
choices.matters: Opus: 18 cells (time, knot strength and mistake averages). Sonnet: 2 cells (mistake averages).

choices.topic: Drop a recorded zero knot-spread value?
choices.opus: Treated the 0 mm spread as a failed knot and set it to missing (499 values instead of 500).
choices.sonnet: Kept it (500 spread values) in the spread model.
choices.authors: Kept the zero spread value in the spread model.
choices.matters: Opus: 7 spread cells (effects, ranges, one p-value). Sonnet: none from this choice.

choices.topic: How are confidence ranges and p-values worked out?
choices.opus: Linear models: t reference with about 440 degrees of freedom. Mistakes model: normal-curve (Wald z) ranges.
choices.sonnet: Normal-curve (Wald z, 1.96) ranges and p-values for the linear models and the mistakes model.
choices.authors: Not known; a t reference of about 437 degrees of freedom closes one knot-strength p-value gap.
choices.matters: Not established as a cause of any missed cell for either model.

choices.topic: Estimation method for the mistakes (yes/no) model?
choices.opus: Laplace approximation (the R glmer default), random intercept per participant.
choices.sonnet: 15-point adaptive quadrature, own implementation because the usual R package was unavailable.
choices.authors: Laplace method (R glmer default); their numbers match it exactly.
choices.matters: No cells attributed. Story notes 15 points gives odds ratio 2.312 instead of 2.294 (Sonnet).

choices.topic: Adjust for the order in which techniques were done?
choices.opus: No order term: technique plus run, with a random intercept per participant, for all four outcomes.
choices.sonnet: Same: technique plus run, random intercept per participant, no order term.
choices.authors: Added each technique's position in the sequence (first, second, third) as an extra factor in every mixed model.
choices.matters: Opus: 12 cells, Sonnet: 13 cells, mainly mistake odds ratios and ranges, plus one time p-value.

choices.topic: Handle the one knot-strength value of exactly zero?
choices.opus: Dropped it from the knot-strength model, since the log of zero is undefined.
choices.sonnet: Dropped it from the knot-strength model only.
choices.authors: Replaced the 0 with 0.1 mm (the measuring step) and kept the knot.
choices.matters: Both models: 6 knot-strength cells (effects, one upper limit, p-values).

choices.topic: How are runs with missing measurements handled?
choices.opus: Each outcome uses its own available runs; participants stay in the model with the runs they have.
choices.sonnet: Same: each outcome on its own available runs; participants with missing runs stay in.

choices.topic: Include a technique-by-run interaction in Table 1 model?
choices.opus: No interaction: technique plus run with random intercept per participant, since the Methods add it only within runs.
choices.sonnet: Same: no interaction, random intercept per subject.

choices.topic: Which log base for the log-transformed outcomes?
choices.opus: Natural log; ratios and p-values do not depend on the base.
